name: Hangzhou Gold Electronic Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Gold Electronic Equipment Co., Ltd. manufactures battery testing and battery management systems. The company offers BMS (battery management system) focuses on battery capacity and characteristics analysis, and research development of battery testing equipment. The company offers energy storage BMS modules and related products, integrated centralize control unit and data services, backup power supply, and power battery BMS module. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Hangzhou, China.
